import json
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap, Normalize

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

sp = pd.DataFrame(data['education_spending']['data'])
pi = pd.DataFrame(data['pisa_scores']['data'])
te = pd.DataFrame(data['tertiary_enrollment']['data'])
yu = pd.DataFrame(data['youth_unemployment']['data'])

df = sp.merge(pi, on='country').merge(te, on='country').merge(yu, on='country')

plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 9), dpi=180)
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#fbfaf8')
ax.set_facecolor('#fbfaf8')

cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('editorial_div', ['#1f4e79', '#f1f1f1', '#b23a48'])
norm = Normalize(vmin=df['youth_unemp_rate'].min(), vmax=df['youth_unemp_rate'].max())

sizes = (df['enrollment_rate'] - df['enrollment_rate'].min()) / (df['enrollment_rate'].max() - df['enrollment_rate'].min())
sizes = 180 + sizes * 1400

sc = ax.scatter(
    df['edu_spending_pct_gdp'],
    df['pisa_avg'],
    s=sizes,
    c=df['youth_unemp_rate'],
    cmap=cmap,
    norm=norm,
    alpha=0.85,
    edgecolors='#2f2f2f',
    linewidths=0.7,
)

x = df['edu_spending_pct_gdp'].values
y = df['pisa_avg'].values
coef = np.polyfit(x, y, 2)
poly = np.poly1d(coef)
x_line = np.linspace(x.min()-0.1, x.max()+0.1, 300)
y_line = poly(x_line)
ax.plot(x_line, y_line, color='#4a4a4a', linestyle='--', linewidth=2.0, alpha=0.9, label='Quadratic trend (visual guide)')

label_countries = {
    'Singapore','Japan','South Korea','Estonia','Finland',
    'Costa Rica','Brazil','Israel','Greece','Mexico','Chile','Italy','Spain'
}
for _, r in df.iterrows():
    if r['country'] in label_countries:
        ax.annotate(
            r['country'],
            (r['edu_spending_pct_gdp'], r['pisa_avg']),
            textcoords='offset points',
            xytext=(5, 5),
            fontsize=9,
            color='#222222'
        )

ax.set_title(
    'Education Spending vs Learning and Labor Outcomes (30 Countries)',
    fontsize=18,
    weight='bold',
    color='#222222',
    pad=16,
)
ax.set_xlabel('Education Spending (% of GDP)', fontsize=12, color='#222222')
ax.set_ylabel('PISA Average Score (points)', fontsize=12, color='#222222')

ax.set_xlim(2.6, 7.5)
ax.set_ylim(df['pisa_avg'].min()-10, df['pisa_avg'].max()+12)
ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=10, colors='#333333')

cbar = plt.colorbar(sc, ax=ax, pad=0.02)
cbar.set_label('Youth Unemployment Rate (% ages 15–24 labor force)', fontsize=11)
cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=9)

legend_sizes = [50, 75, 100]
legend_marker_sizes = []
for v in legend_sizes:
    s = 180 + ((v - df['enrollment_rate'].min()) / (df['enrollment_rate'].max() - df['enrollment_rate'].min())) * 1400
    legend_marker_sizes.append(s)

handles = [
    plt.scatter([], [], s=legend_marker_sizes[i], color='#bdbdbd', edgecolors='#2f2f2f', linewidths=0.6, alpha=0.9)
    for i in range(len(legend_sizes))
]
labels = [f'{v}% enrollment' for v in legend_sizes]
leg1 = ax.legend(handles, labels, title='Bubble Size:\nTertiary Enrollment Rate',
                 scatterpoints=1, frameon=True, fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10,
                 loc='lower left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.01, 0.01))
leg1.get_frame().set_facecolor('#f7f6f4')
leg1.get_frame().set_edgecolor('#cccccc')
ax.add_artist(leg1)

leg2 = ax.legend(loc='upper right', frameon=True, fontsize=9)
leg2.get_frame().set_facecolor('#f7f6f4')
leg2.get_frame().set_edgecolor('#cccccc')

ax.text(
    0.5,
    -0.13,
    'Encoding: x = education spending (% GDP), y = PISA score, bubble size = tertiary enrollment (%), color = youth unemployment (%)\nData sources: OECD/World Bank/PISA/ILO estimates (circa 2022–2023)',
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    ha='center',
    va='top',
    fontsize=9,
    color='#4a4a4a'
)

for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_color('#9a9a9a')
    spine.set_linewidth(0.8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor=fig.get_facecolor())

import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap, Normalize

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

sp = {d['country']: d for d in data['education_spending']['data']}
pi = {d['country']: d for d in data['pisa_scores']['data']}
te = {d['country']: d for d in data['tertiary_enrollment']['data']}
yu = {d['country']: d for d in data['youth_unemployment']['data']}

    records.append({
        'country': c,
        'edu_spending_pct_gdp': sp[c]['edu_spending_pct_gdp'],
        'pisa_avg': pi[c]['pisa_avg'],

        'youth_unemp_rate': yu[c]['youth_unemp_rate'],
    })

x = np.array([r['edu_spending_pct_gdp'] for r in records], dtype=float)
y = np.array([r['pisa_avg'] for r in records], dtype=float)
enroll = np.array([r['enrollment_rate'] for r in records], dtype=float)
unemp = np.array([r['youth_unemp_rate'] for r in records], dtype=float)
